items.title: Ask for feedback
items.detail: You reached Screening or later. One useful point can improve your next interview.
items.draft:
Hi,

Thank you for letting me know, and for considering me for the Staff SRE role. I appreciate your time.

I accept the decision and am not asking you to reconsider. I am trying to improve for future opportunities, so I would really appreciate one or two specific points on what most influenced the decision.

If detailed feedback is not possible, even a short indication would help: technical fit (which area), communication or collaboration, relevant experience or role-specific knowledge, or compensation expectations above the budget. If it was something else, that is useful too.

A single sentence is plenty; if possible, one example or one thing to work on would help me turn it into a practical improvement.

Thank you again.

insight.headline: Make your database failover answers more concrete
insight.detail: Practise one incident story: failure, trade-offs, recovery and verification.
insight.lesson: Demo evidence: three applications, two employers, interview reviews and employer feedback. Fictional data.

summary: Reply to recruiters first, then review ready applications.
